headlines.text: On this day in 2023, Willie Mack stepped through the curtain for the first time against Brian Cage, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.14.
Flash back to 2021, when Leyla Hirsch stepped back through the curtain after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
2024 brought us this moment: Collision stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.03.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2021, Guevara & Hager announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.30.
Flash back to 2024, when Daniel Garcia vs. Buddy Matthews locked horns for the first time on Collision, rated 7.64 ? a well-worked match.
Looking back to 2023, when Action Andretti vs. Daniel Garcia headlined Rampage, rated 6.39 in a hard-fought men's division clash.
